steps.thought: List available tests to understand the test suite and select the most cost-effective initial diagnostics.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest as the cheapest initial test to check basic device enumeration across I2C, UART, and CAN.
steps.observation: The power_on_selftest passed successfully, enumerating all expected CAN nodes, UART devices, camera sensor, I2C IMU, and compass. This rules out major power-on initialization, bus disconnection, and basic boot faults.

hypotheses.rationale: Only the power_on_selftest has been run; functional, sensor, motor, and load tests are needed to reveal any hidden faults.
Initial boot selftest passed, but all other subsystems must be tested before confirming a healthy unit.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_rest_check to verify cell voltages and pack rest status, as we must check all subsystems before declaring the unit healthy.
steps.observation: The battery_rest_check passed successfully with balanced cell voltages totaling 16.6V and no cell imbalance, ruling out battery rest anomalies or weak cells at rest.

hypotheses.rationale: Basic power and battery rest checks passed, but comprehensive functional, motor, sensor, and load tests must be run to locate any potential faults.
Initial tests on power-on and battery rest are normal, pending verification across the remaining subsystems.

steps.thought: I will run the esc_telemetry test to check for ESC commutation errors and packet loss, which is a cheap and direct way to evaluate the ESC subsystem.
steps.observation: The esc_telemetry test passed successfully across all four ESCs with zero sync errors and normal operating temperatures, ruling out major ESC commutation failures or severe packet loss.

hypotheses.rationale: Power-on, battery rest, and ESC telemetry tests have all passed normally without major faults, though tests for motors, sensors, harness, and load remain.
Further subsystem tests are required before a definitive diagnosis can be made.

steps.thought: I will run the compass_static test to check compass heading accuracy against the reference fixture before proceeding to other subsystem checks.
steps.observation: The compass_static test passed successfully with a minimal heading error of -0.36 degrees and a normal field magnitude of 51.65 uT, ruling out static compass interference or hard-iron distortion.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial system, battery rest, ESC telemetry, and static compass tests have all passed normally.
Motor spin tests have not yet been performed to check for mechanical vibration or bearing issues.
IMU static testing has not yet been executed to verify gyro and accelerometer noise characteristics.

steps.thought: Run camera_selftest to check camera functionality, covering the camera subsystem.
steps.observation: The camera_selftest failed with a low frame rate of 20.8 fps and 258 CSI CRC errors, indicating a faulty camera ribbon cable or camera sensor module.

hypotheses.rationale: High CSI CRC errors and low frame rate during camera selftest strongly point to a damaged or loose CSI ribbon cable.
The camera self-test failure and frame rate drop could alternatively indicate an internal failure within the camera sensor module itself.

steps.thought: I need to check the search failure library for similar camera CSI CRC errors and low frame rates to distinguish between a ribbon cable fault and a dead camera sensor.

args.query: camera selftest failed frame rate 20.8 fps CSI CRC errors 258

matches.title: Camera self-test fails with CSI CRC errors
matches.symptom_summary: Camera sensor ID reads correctly but self test fails. Frame rate below 28 fps and many CSI CRC errors on the data lanes.
matches.root_cause: CSI ribbon cable creased or partially inserted in the connector.
matches.rework_notes: Reseat the ribbon; replace it if creased.

matches.title: Camera frame rate low, no CRC errors
matches.symptom_summary: Camera self test reports frame rate around 15 fps with zero CRC errors and sensor ID OK. Camera firmware version string does not match the release.
matches.root_cause: Camera module shipped with old firmware set to a low frame rate mode.
matches.rework_notes: Update camera firmware. Zero CRC errors separates it from a ribbon fault.

matches.title: Camera not detected, no frames
matches.symptom_summary: Power-on self test cannot read the camera sensor ID. Camera self test fails with zero fps and zero CRC errors, meaning no data arrives at all.
matches.root_cause: Dead image sensor on the camera module.

steps.observation: The camera_selftest failed with a low frame rate and high CSI CRC errors, matching historical failure records for a camera ribbon fault rather than a dead sensor or firmware mismatch.

hypotheses.rationale: High CSI CRC errors and low frame rate during camera_selftest match historical cases for a creased or partially inserted CSI ribbon cable.
Although camera_selftest failed, sensor ID was successfully read during power_on_selftest, making a completely dead sensor less likely than a ribbon fault.

steps.thought: The camera selftest failure with high CSI CRC errors matches a camera ribbon fault. We can conclude the diagnosis and propose reseating the ribbon cable.
steps.observation: Rework applied; full suite passed: True.
